confirmation_documents_source_check.name: confirmation_documents_source_check
confirmation_documents_source_check.value: "confirmation_documents"."stay_id" is not null or "confirmation_documents"."travel_plan_id" is not null or "confirmation_documents"."expense_id" is not null

coordinator_thread_links_main_has_no_par.name: coordinator_thread_links_main_has_no_parent
coordinator_thread_links_main_has_no_par.value: "coordinator_thread_links"."kind" <> 'main' or ("coordinator_thread_links"."parent_thread_id" is null and "coordinator_thread_links"."brief" is null)

coordinator_turn_executions_running_clai.name: coordinator_turn_executions_running_claim
coordinator_turn_executions_running_clai.value: "coordinator_turn_executions"."status" <> 'running' or ("coordinator_turn_executions"."claim_token" is not null and "coordinator_turn_executions"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

itinerary_items_pin_complete.name: itinerary_items_pin_complete
itinerary_items_pin_complete.value:
("itinerary_items"."pin_latitude" IS NULL AND "itinerary_items"."pin_longitude" IS NULL AND "itinerary_items"."pin_precision" IS NULL AND "itinerary_items"."pin_source" IS NULL)
    OR ("itinerary_items"."pin_latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "itinerary_items"."pin_longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180
      AND "itinerary_items"."pin_precision" IN ('exact', 'approximate') AND "itinerary_items"."pin_source" IN ('map_link', 'page', 'placed'))

operator_actions_bounds.name: operator_actions_bounds
operator_actions_bounds.value: length("operator_actions"."subject_id") between 1 and 80 and ("operator_actions"."note" is null or length("operator_actions"."note") <= 300)

participant_questions_bounds.name: participant_questions_bounds
participant_questions_bounds.value: length("participant_questions"."question") between 1 and 300 and length("participant_questions"."purpose") between 1 and 160 and "participant_questions"."version" > 0 and "participant_questions"."answer_revision" >= 0

partner_inquiries_bounds.name: partner_inquiries_bounds
partner_inquiries_bounds.value: length("partner_inquiries"."organization") between 1 and 160 and length("partner_inquiries"."contact_name") between 1 and 120 and length("partner_inquiries"."contact_email") between 3 and 254 and length("partner_inquiries"."message") between 10 and 2000 and "partner_inquiries"."delivery_attempts" >= 0

payment_reports_bounds.name: payment_reports_bounds
payment_reports_bounds.value: "payment_reports"."amount_cents" > 0 and "payment_reports"."amount_cents" <= 100000000 and length("payment_reports"."currency") = 3 and ("payment_reports"."note" is null or length("payment_reports"."note") <= 200) and "payment_reports"."reported_by_person_id" <> "payment_reports"."to_person_id"

personal_coordinator_bounds_check.name: personal_coordinator_bounds_check
personal_coordinator_bounds_check.value: length("personal_coordinator_turns"."user_text") between 1 and 1800 and ("personal_coordinator_turns"."reply" is null or length("personal_coordinator_turns"."reply") between 1 and 4000) and "personal_coordinator_turns"."attempt" between 1 and 3

recipe_outcomes_applied_consistent.name: recipe_outcomes_applied_consistent
recipe_outcomes_applied_consistent.value: ("recipe_outcomes"."status" = 'applied') = ("recipe_outcomes"."applied_at" is not null and "recipe_outcomes"."applied_targets" is not null and "recipe_outcomes"."applied_by_person_id" is not null) or "recipe_outcomes"."status" = 'superseded'

stays_pin_complete.name: stays_pin_complete
stays_pin_complete.value:
("stays"."pin_latitude" IS NULL AND "stays"."pin_longitude" IS NULL AND "stays"."pin_precision" IS NULL AND "stays"."pin_source" IS NULL)
    OR ("stays"."pin_latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "stays"."pin_longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180
      AND "stays"."pin_precision" IN ('exact', 'approximate') AND "stays"."pin_source" IN ('map_link', 'page', 'placed'))

trip_usage_bounds.name: trip_usage_bounds
trip_usage_bounds.value: "trip_usage_events"."units" between 1 and 10000 and ("trip_usage_events"."cost_micros" is null or "trip_usage_events"."cost_micros" >= 0)

workflow_templates_bounds.name: workflow_templates_bounds
workflow_templates_bounds.value: "workflow_templates"."version" > 0 and "workflow_templates"."key" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{2,63}$' and length("workflow_templates"."title") between 1 and 120 and length("workflow_templates"."description") between 1 and 500 and length("workflow_templates"."instructions") between 20 and 12000
